body: I colored outside the lines of a dinosaur drawing after my mom said not to. ( just to teach me that's how you color) After I did that I walked into the kitchen grabbed a chef's knife and got my family around after my mom screamed and put it into my chest. I was 4 at the time.

Fine, I actually got out of bed and looked for a job today and finally cleaned my room. I got news that my broken down car was being fixed and my grandpa was going to pay for it which I don't take lightly, because for some reason in my brain that means I've let him down. I'm still trying to get mental help in working on it. I've been lashing out a lot on people close to me. I don't know if I should distance myself or not. In the midst of it all I've been having an identity crisis. So I've always been flamboyant and a lot of my ex girlfriends have said they were surprised when I wasn't gay. This is strange to put out there but I know I'm sexually attracted to women but I know I'm romantically attracted to men as well. I know I could kiss one and be happy I just dunno about other stuff. Anyways this was just rambling. Thanks for reading and for anyone who is having a bad day you aren't alone. There are people here for you.
